caption_L1: Here a bar graph is called Confirmed cases and deaths of major virus outbreaks worldwide in the last 50 years as of 2020. The x-axis plots Virus (year identified) as categorical scale starting with 2019-nCoV* (2020) and ending with SARS (2002) while the y-axis plots Deaths using linear scale from 0 to 300,000.
caption_L2L3: Major virus outbreaks are rare, and affect proportionally few people when they do arise. The major virus in the last 50 years was H1N1. Only two virus outbreaks in the last 50 years have caused confirmed cases and deaths in the tens of thousands.
